mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as long as the rate remains near historic lows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.0%) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both below 3-month moving average
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A supply shock indicated by INDPRO below 100.0 (index 2017=100) reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS above 149000 thousand persons) support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 149000 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market slowdown regime (HOUST below 1500 thousand units), reduced construction activity and consumer confidence lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1500 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent weakness in employment growth (PAYEMS < 149000) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.2%) signals labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS < 149000 and UNRATE > 4.2 over any 3-year rolling window.
